% Arabica
, also known as
% ΔRΔBICΔ
, is an international Japanese specialty
[
2
]
[
3
]
coffee
chain brand based in
Kyoto, Japan
.
The company's international flagship and headquarters are located in Kyoto. Its first location opened in
Hong Kong
in 2013 and, as of June 2025, has grown to 236 locations globally.
[
4
]
Company history
The coffee brand was founded by Kenneth Shoji.
[
5
]
After the
Tōhoku earthquake
destroyed his house in
Fukushima Prefecture
in 2011, he moved to
Hong Kong
.
[
6
]
After moving, he decided to start a
coffee
business so he traveled to
Hawaii
and purchased a
coffee farm
.
[
7
]
In 2013, Shoji opened the first % Arabica
café
in Hong Kong. In 2014, the worldwide flagship store in the
Kyoto
's historic
Higashiyama
district was opened.
[
1
]
The store's location also serves as the company's global headquarters location.
[
1
]
% Arabica was described as "Japan's cult-favorite hit coffee shop" by
Eater
.
[
8
]
In 2022, during
The London Coffee Festival
, % Arabica won the "Most Notable New Cafe" award in the
UK Coffee Awards 2022
.
[
9
]
The coffee brand is known for using its custom-made espresso machines, manufactured in Seattle, that provide baristas with more control while creating craft drinks.

Coffee shop aesthetic
% Arabica's stores focus on having a clean, minimalist style fitting the Japanese design principles of simple beauty while having local design elements inspired by the countries in which they are based. Founder Kenneth has collaborated with several architects and design studios such as B.L.U.E. Architecture,

% Arabica's largest international presence is in mainland China, where it operates 88 stores.
[
39
]
% Arabica expanded to Thailand in June 2020, opening a 250m
2
store in Bangkok's
Iconsiam
center which was described as the city's most popular specialty coffee cafe.
[
40
]
At the time, it was the brand's 48th global outpost.
[
40
]
The first U.S. cafe opened in
Dumbo, Brooklyn
on  June 11, 2021.
[
6
]
Most locations of % Arabica are franchise operations, however, the three locations in Kyoto are corporate managed.
[
41
]
In August 2022, % Arabica opened its first store in Taiwan located at the foot of Taipei Elephant Mountain and the first Bali store at Kuta Beachwalk Mall. It is the first % Arabica store to forgo the usage of plastic cups, a standard that all % Arabica stores to follow in the future.
[
42
]
[
43
]
[
44
]
The stores were quickly followed by the first location in South Korea, opening in Seoul's
Gangnam district
in September 2022.
[
45
]
The store marked % Arabica's 113th global location.
